footnote_text: On October 28, 2026, the Issuer's Compensation, Nominating and Governance Committee granted the Reporting Person 422,486 shares of restricted stock under the Issuer's 2025 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. The award was valued at $360,000 based on the closing price of the Issuer's common stock on the grant date. The shares vest in full on March 31, 2027, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through that date.

On October 28, 2026, the Issuer's Compensation, Nominating and Governance Committee (the "Committee") granted the Reporting Person 938,857 shares of restricted stock under the Issuer's 2025 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. The award was valued at $800,000 based on the closing price of the Issuer's common stock on the grant date. The shares vest in full on March 31, 2027, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through that date.
